turns.text: Hello. I would like to return a catalogue print. It does not suit the wall.
Hello, I can help with a return. First I need to verify your order. Please send me the order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with.
The order is SC-5211 and the email is ysolde.macinca@example.com. It arrived within the last two weeks.

Thank you, your order SC-5211 is verified. I have filed a return request for the print Păunul de ceață (40x50 cm), reference R-1. It is pending approval, and staff must approve the refund. Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, and the customer pays the return postage. Please keep the print in good condition until staff confirm the return.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

turns.text: I will pay the return postage. Please file the return for the team to approve. I am not asking for a reprint.

Thank you. Your return request R-1 for order SC-5211 is already filed and waiting for staff approval, so I have not filed it again. You will pay the return postage, as the policy says. The refund needs staff approval.
